headline: Arena Archery: ceilings catch arrows now
lede: Shafts that rise into thick stone hang tip-up under the lowest course instead of vanishing into it — swaying, pullable, and honest about what the bots can see. The thin-canopy half shipped as a ruling question with the arena receipts left byte-identical to the game players know.

notes.text: Thick-ceiling undersides merged (#2579 stage 1): rising hits hang in the air below multi-course stone, wear the -75° ceiling family, sway without knocking, and walk home on pull/TTL.
All three arena autopilot duels are byte-identical to the old build — the #2377 tempo promise holds by construction, not re-tuning. 170/170 sim gates, 13/13 mutants die.
Single-row canopy hangs are paused pending Jon's ruling (jonq #2585): measured, one hang under a spawn corridor re-knits KNOCKBACK into a duel past the heat bell.
The old blocker's story was wrong — an ownership-stream probe proved no enemy arrow was ever harvested; the fix direction changed with it. Receipts first, story second.
